certificates.name: C_o0
certificates.statement: ||(I - K_0)^-1 f|| <= C ||f|| for every sigma-odd f
certificates.supersedes_for_R4: R3 C_o0 <= 20.4322 (strong-Markov coupling bound), which remains valid

certificates.method: polynomial supersolution of E_x[tau] with the frozen Pair kernel
certificates.name: C_e0
